name: Elise Marlowe
bio: Elise Marlowe is the editor of The Gilded Skin. She researches beauty tools, skincare routines and vanity organization, reads the dermatology and regulatory sources behind each guide, and writes about what is worth buying and who should skip it. She is not a dermatologist, and her guides say clearly when they are based on research rather than hands-on testing.

name: The Gilded Skin Editors
bio: Articles under this byline are researched, written and edited by The Gilded Skin's editorial team using the sources cited on each page. We are not dermatologists or medical professionals, and we say clearly when a guide is based on research rather than hands-on testing.
